owner_calls.question: Step 2 (Deadpool & Wolverine) sets this file's Frank Castle (the 2004 film's, Earth-58732) to Deceased. On screen, though, the dead Resistance Punisher is never identified: Gambit only names 'the Punisher' among those Cassandra Nova killed, and Deadpool asks 'Which Punisher? There's been, like, five of them.' Fan wikis treat him as an unidentified variant who could be the 1989, 2004 or War Zone Punisher. Should this file keep the record and the Deceased status?
options: Keep as is (the text already says Frank never appears and the identity is unclear)
Keep the record but don't change his status (leave the last status from The Punisher (2004))
owner_calls.evidence: In Deadpool & Wolverine, Gambit says: 'Every time one of us has gone up against her, they die. The Punisher, the Quicksilver, the Daredevil.' Deadpool later asks: 'Which Punisher? There's been, like, five of them.' The fandom character page is 'AT4 Owner Punisher', a mentioned-only variant whose identity is conjecture, and it says he could be the Lundgren, Jane or Stevenson Punisher.
